title: ADR with wrong kind value
context: An ADR whose kind is not the const value adr.
decision: Test that a non-adr kind is rejected.
forbiddenDrift: Do not set kind to any value other than adr.
aiAlignmentRules: Stop if kind disagrees with the schema const.
permittedChanges: The kind value may be corrected by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: kind is 'schema', not the const 'adr'.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because kind is not adr.
